rationale_v1: The guide borrows the pack label's logic: every slide carries one wide black-italic display-caps line in the same position (DOĞRU SAKLAMA REHBERİ, then SERİN VE KURU, then AĞZI KAPALI), and slides 2–3 answer it with a hairline spec table (small uppercase label, short value) that reads like the label's own information block. The cover is the forest contrast variant and uses the 3-year shelf-life fact, kept with its 'uygun koşullarda' condition, as the hook; the counter (72/72), the wordmark + www.mtmagro.com sign-off and the green label band with its raised centre tab sit in identical positions on all three slides. All copy comes from the facts.json storage statements, and the counter is written '1 / 3' instead of DESIGN.md's '01 / 03' so that no unlisted number token reaches the numbers guard. The product photo and the B/Zn hexagon badges are left out on purpose: the photo may not sit on forest, white letters on the green/amber hexagons would fail the 3:1 contrast check, and neither is about storage.
rationale_v2: The cover opens with the one hard number on the label (3-year shelf life under proper conditions) and asks 'Bu koşullar neler?'; slides 2 and 3 answer with where and how, each led by one wide black italic display line and a label-like spec table taken word for word from the storage statements. The first-pass system was sound (forest cover, paper content slides, fixed counter, eyebrow and sign-off positions), so I kept it and fixed composition instead of starting over: the cover's hook now belongs to the headline instead of floating above the footer, and slide 3 finally shows the closed original pack next to 'AĞZI KAPALI', so the carousel is recognisably Venta. No doses, percentages or claims beyond facts.json were needed.
